name: masher Re:loaded ~Takasaka Yui no Owaranai Natsu~
original_name: masher Re:loaded ～高坂唯の終わらない夏～
source: Remake of Bad Name and masher featuring new visuals and voice acting for main heroine. It also acts as a sequel to Bad Name, since it has a new route/continuation.
translation: 本作是《Bad Name》与《masher》的重制版，焕新了画面表现，并为女主角追加了角色配音。同时本作也新增了一条后续路线与日后谈剧情，可视作《Bad Name》的续篇。
